mapper.select: SELECT d.cd_grp_id AS grp,d.dtl_cd AS code,d.cd_nm AS name FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g USING(cd_grp_id) WHERE d.cd_grp_id='FIN_CATEGORY' AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY d.sort_seq,d.dtl_cd

SELECT m.trns_cd_grp_id AS grp,m.excel_lbl_nm AS label,m.trns_cd AS code FROM cmn.excel_map m JOIN cmn.cd_dtl d ON d.cd_grp_id=m.trns_cd_grp_id AND d.dtl_cd=m.trns_cd JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=d.cd_grp_id WHERE m.trns_cd_grp_id='FIN_CATEGORY' AND m.use_yn='Y' AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y'
SELECT upld_stts_cd FROM sys.upld WHERE upld_id=#{id} AND form_cd='B.2'
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE fin.mth_cls IN SHARE MODE; LOCK TABLE fin.entry IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys.upld(upld_id,form_cd,scrn_id,obj_ym,file_nm,file_path_addr, tot_row_cnt,nrml_row_cnt,err_row_cnt,wrn_row_cnt,upld_stts_cd,ovwr_yn,upld_user_id) VALUES(#{review.id},'B.2','UI-10',#{review.month},#{review.name},#{review.path}, #{result.row_count},greatest(0,#{result.row_count}-#{result.error_count}),#{result.error_count},#{result.warning_count},#{status},'Y',#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(upld_id) DO UPDATE SET upld_stts_cd=EXCLUDED.upld_stts_cd, tot_row_cnt=EXCLUDED.tot_row_cnt,nrml_row_cnt=EXCLUDED.nrml_row_cnt, err_row_cnt=EXCLUDED.err_row_cnt,wrn_row_cnt=EXCLUDED.wrn_row_cnt
